description: This script is a test file for integrating with an issue tracking system (specifically 'tracxmlrpc') in a TestLink environment. It loads configuration, initializes interface object, and performs read operations on issues, including retrieving issue details and checking existence.

classes.name: tracxmlrpcInterface
classes.description: A class that interfaces with a tracxmlrpc-based issue tracker, providing methods to retrieve issue details and check bug existence.

classes.name: dBug
classes.description: A debugging utility class used to dump variable contents for debugging purposes.

methods.name: tracxmlrpcInterface->__construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the interface with project ID and configuration.

methods.name: tracxmlrpcInterface->getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves details of an issue by its ID.

methods.name: tracxmlrpcInterface->checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if a bug with a specified ID exists in the tracker.
